content: So old, in fact, that the upcoming 25th anniversary of the Xbox and Halo: Combat Evolved immediately made me think about the LAN parties my brother and I used to host in middle and high school. There were a dozen or so teenage boys, four TVs, and enough Ethernet cable to turn my parents’ house into a tripping hazard that could also burst into flames at any moment. I’ve played countless multiplayer games since, but none have come close to the majesty of those experiences.
